info.name: 1Factory Gets a List of NCRs for Your Organization

params.name: page
params.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.

params.name: created_after
params.description: Return objects created after the specified date-time

params.name: created_before
params.description: Return objects created before the specified date-time

params.name: updated_after
params.description: Return objects updated after the specified date-time

params.name: updated_before
params.description: Return objects updated before the specified date-time

params.name: closed_after
params.description: Return only approved or rejected objects closed after the specified date-time.

params.name: closed_before
params.description: Return only approved or rejected objects closed before the specified date-time.

items.docs:
The list of NCRs can be filtered by specifying query parameters.

Paging parameters control the number of rows NCR objects returned. By default, the first 100 NCRs are returned.
